status.en: 7 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 42% fewer than the week before, most of them in Juba, Rumbek and Morobo.
status.nb: 7 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 42 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Juba, Rumbek og Morobo.

summary.en: A drone strike hit the Amiet market in Abyei, killing dozens, while coordinated cattle raids in Warrup state killed at least 72 people. Fighting continues in Upper Nile, where the Chollo King was airlifted to Juba and the Upper Nile Deputy Governor visited Baliet County after the deadly Adong attack, and Machar disputes Bol Mel’s claims over the Nasir attack. The SSPDF and SPLA-IO forces clashed in Wij-Panyikang, Upper Nile, and the UN commission warned that the peace deal is being dismantled. The UCDP recorded 2 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Et droneangrep rammet Amiet-markedet i Abyei, og drepte dusinvis, mens ko-raid i Warrup-stat ble koordinert og drepte minst 72 personer. Kampene fortsetter i Upper Nile, hvor Chollo-kongen ble lufttransportert til Juba og visepresidenten i Upper Nile besøkte Baliet fylke etter det dødelige Adong-angrepet, og Machar bestrider Bol Mels påstander om Nasir-angrepet. SAF og SPLA-IO styrker kolliderte i Wij-Panyikang, Upper Nile, og FN-kommisjonen advarte om at fredsavtalen blir demontert. UCDP registrerte 2 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: South Sudanese Civil War
background.extract: The South Sudanese Civil War was a multi-sided civil war in South Sudan fought from 2013 to 2018 between government and opposition forces. The civil war caused rampant human rights abuses, including forced displacement, ethnic massacres, and killings of journalists by various parties. Since the war's end, South Sudan has been governed by a coalition formed by leaders of the former warring factions, Salva Kiir Mayardit and Riek Machar. The country continues to recover from the war while experiencing ongoing and systemic ethnic violence.
